**Paris Get‑away: 7‑Day Itinerary (Mid‑April 2025)**  
*(Assumes you’re flying from New York City – JFK – to Paris‑Charles de Gaulle (CDG). Adjust dates and flights as needed.)*

| Day | Time | Activity | Notes |
|-----|------|----------|-------|
| **1** | 08:00 – 12:30 | Flight JFK → CDG | 7‑hr flight, 2‑hr layover in London (if connecting). |
| | 13:30 | Arrive CDG, take RER B to Gare du Nord | 30 min, €10. |
| | 14:30 | Check‑in, Hotel Le Marais | 3‑star boutique, €180/night. |
| | 16:00 | Walk to Notre‑Dame & Île de la Cité | Free, photo ops. |
| | 19:00 | Dinner at **Le Coupe‑Chou** | Classic French, €45 per person. |
| **2** | 08:00 | Breakfast at hotel | Included. |
| | 09:30 | Louvre Museum | Pre‑book tickets (€17). 3‑hr visit. |
| | 13:00 | Lunch at **Café Marly** | €25 per person. |
| | 15:00 | Walk along Seine to Musée d’Orsay | 30 min stroll. |
| | 17:30 | Coffee at **Café de Flore** | €12 per person. |
| | 20:00 | Dinner cruise on the Seine | €70 per person. |
| **3** | 07:30 | Day trip to Versailles | Train TGV €20 round‑trip. |
| | 09:30 | Palace & Gardens tour | 4‑hr. |
| | 14:00 | Picnic lunch (bought at Versailles market) | €15 per person. |
| | 18:00 | Return to Paris, relax at hotel |  |
| | 20:30 | Dinner at **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** | €120 per person. |
| **4** | 08:00 | Breakfast at hotel | Included. |
| | 09:30 | Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur | Free, 2‑hr walk. |
| | 12:30 | Lunch at **Le Consulat** | €20 per person. |
| | 14:00 | Visit **Espace Dalí** | €12 per person. |
| | 16:00 | Explore Place du Tertre | Free. |
| | 19:00 | Dinner at **La Maison Rose** | €35 per person. |
| **5** | 08:00 | Breakfast at hotel | Included. |
| | 09:30 | Eiffel Tower (top level) | Pre‑book tickets (€25). 2‑hr visit. |
| | 12:00 | Picnic at Champ de Mars | €10 per person. |
| | 14:00 | Visit **Musée Quai Branly** | €12 per person. |
| | 17:00 | Stroll along the Seine to **Pont Alexandre III** | Free. |
| | 20:00 | Dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Eiffel Tower) | €200 per person. |
| **6** | 08:00 | Breakfast at hotel | Included. |
| | 09:30 | Day trip to Giverny (Monet’s Garden) | Train €15 round‑trip. |
| | 10:30 | Monet’s House & Gardens | 3‑hr visit. |
| | 14:00 | Lunch in Giverny (bistro) | €18 per person. |
| | 18:00 | Return to Paris |  |
| | 20:30 | Dinner at **Septime** | €90 per person. |
| **7** | 08:00 | Breakfast at hotel | Included. |
| | 09:30 | Last‑minute shopping on Rue Saint‑Honoré |  |
| | 12:00 | Lunch at **L’Avenue** | €30 per person. |
| | 14:00 | Check‑out, head to CDG |  |
| | 17:00 | Flight CDG → JFK | 7‑hr flight. |

---

### Budget Summary (per person)

| Category | Cost (€) |
|----------|----------|
| Flights (JFK ↔ CDG) | 650 |
| Accommodation (6 nights) | 1,080 |
| Meals (average €60/day) | 420 |
| Attractions & tickets | 250 |
| Transport (metro, RER, trains) | 120 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | 100 |
| **Total** | **3,420** |

*(Prices are approximate and may vary by season. Book early for best rates.)*

---

### Packing Checklist

| Item | Why |
|------|-----|
| Light jacket & umbrella | April can be rainy |
| Comfortable walking shoes | Paris is best explored on foot |
| Power adapter (Type C/F) | EU plugs |
| Reusable water bottle | Stay hydrated |
| Small daypack | Carry essentials |
| Travel insurance | Coverage for health & cancellations |

---

### Tips & Hacks

1. **Buy a Paris Pass** – If you plan to visit many museums, it can save time and money (includes metro rides).
2. **Reserve restaurants in advance** – Especially for high‑profile spots like Le Jules Verne or Septime.
3. **Use the “Skip‑the‑Line” option** – For Louvre, Eiffel Tower, and other popular sites.
4. **Explore local markets** – Marché Bastille or Marché d’Aligre for fresh food and souvenirs.
5. **Nightlife** – Try a jazz club in Saint‑Germain or a rooftop bar at Hôtel Raphael for sunset views.

---

Enjoy your Paris adventure! Let me know if you’d like to tweak any part of the itinerary or need help booking tickets.
